about.title: We build the unglamorous foundation that makes modern software possible.
about.body: Founded in 2016, NovaGrid is a global team of engineers, designers, and operators on a mission to make enterprise data infrastructure effortless. We believe reliability is a feature, security is non-negotiable, and software should feel light — even when it moves billions of records a day.
